selected_records.title: 100 new UK jobs created as Kuwait buys British-made AI-enabled air defence systems

article.body:
UK MoD announces Kuwait purchase of AI-enabled air-defence systems

The UK Ministry of Defence says Kuwait is buying British-made AI-enabled air-defence systems, with 100 UK jobs created. The announcement identifies a purchase, but the available evidence gives no contract details, supplier, delivery schedule or deployment status. It does not establish that Kuwait has received or operates the systems, or what their AI-enabled capability can do.
